title: Cross-Tradition Coding Matrix: Nineteen Traditions against Seven Capacities
description: Supplementary data for The Irreducible Human (Smárason & Guttesen). The record behind the book's cross-civilisational convergence claim: nineteen traditions (eighteen civilisational, one modern check-row) coded against seven capacity categories, with recurrence and independence tallies (five of the seven capacities clear the four-lineage bar), a consistency check between two AI codings, and a table of the excluded candidate capacities. coding-matrix.csv is machine-readable; the README documents method, tallies, the consistency check, exclusions and provenance, aligned with the printed appendix.
